## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-ef68464d)

## Summary

REV33: close the remaining "can I use this without guessing?" gaps — four real defects found by auditing the whole widget tree plus real-GUI verification.

**1. Wheel-scroll silently edited focused controls.** Qt delivers wheel events to the widget under the cursor; `QAbstractSpinBox`/`QComboBox`/`QAbstractSlider` treat wheel as value-editing, so scrolling a form with the cursor over a focused control silently changed its value. New `wheel_scroll_guard.py` installs an app-level event filter that forwards wheel events on those controls to the nearest `QAbstractScrollArea` viewport instead (with a `QScrollBar` exclusion — it is itself an `QAbstractSlider`, and guarding it would loop the forwarded event forever). Controls in dialogs with no scrollable ancestor keep Qt default behavior. Installed in `native_cad`, `native_editor`, and `room_editor` windows.

**2. Focus-out committed display-rounding noise as phantom edits.** `editingFinished` fires on any focus-out (e.g. clicking 編集終了 while focused), and `QDoubleSpinBox.value()` is rounded to the field's `decimals` — a stored value with finer precision (e.g. `height_m = 2.7000004`) committed `2.7` as a real 「部屋形状を変更」 revision. New `_spin_value_changed(field, stored)` guards (tolerance = half a display step) now sit in both commit paths: standalone `RoomEditorWindow` (height/vertex/edge) **and** workflow `RoomGeometryPanel` (height/vertex/edge/wall-thickness). Real-GUI verification caught the second path after the first commit — this PR includes both.

**3. Navigation explained only some destinations.** Context tab hints existed for ROOM but were empty for all MEASUREMENT/OPTIMIZATION contexts — filled. New `CANONICAL_WORKSPACE_HINTS` + `APPLICATION_DESTINATION_HINTS` map every rail/destination button to a one-line JA purpose (rail buttons and the settings button now show tooltip+WhatsThis). New `deeplink_hint(link)` derives "「X」の「Y」ページを開きます。…" from any `WorkspaceDeepLink`; every overview action button (notices, variant states, secondary domains, pinned next-action) now carries it, plus `WA_AlwaysShowToolTips` so a disabled action still explains itself.

**4. Sweep found ~45 uncovered interactive widgets** beyond what REV32 touched: optimization 詳細 toggles + axis add/remove buttons, import/batch buttons + batch table columns, journey/notice action buttons, all PROJECTS/INBOX/ACTIVITY/LIBRARY/SUPPORT tables (per-column meanings) and buttons. Two structural fixes keep it permanent: `_TooltipForwardingSpinBox` in `room_geometry_panel` (Qt does **not** propagate a spin box's tooltip to its embedded `QLineEdit` — verified empirically, the text area showed nothing) and the same mirror in `optimization_workflow_controller`'s tooltip loop.

Tests: `test_wheel_scroll_guard.py` (4), no-op commit regressions for both editor paths (4), full scoped suite green.

## Verification

Real-GUI verified on Windows (Mesa GL, no offscreen flag): wheel over a focused リピート spinbox scrolls the 測定 page without editing; JA tooltips confirmed on rail/context/action/column-header surfaces; focus-out on 天井高 with seeded `2.7000004` no longer creates a history revision; clean exit (`clean_exit: true`).
